step1_analysis.description: A discrete-time non-inverting integrator using switched capacitors and an operational amplifier. It samples the input voltage on CI during phase 1 and transfers the charge to CF during phase 2, integrating the input signal over time.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10.7-MHz Switched-Opamp Bandpass Sigma-Delta Modulator Using Double-Sampling Finite-Gain-Compensation Technique

voltage_step.description: Output voltage change per integration cycle

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the capacitor ratio and input voltage. Should be exactly 0.1V with ideal components.

settling_time.description: Time required for the output to settle to 90% of its final step value during the integration phase

sky130_expected.calculation: Must settle within half a clock period (10ns for 50MHz)
sky130_expected.reasoning: For 50MHz operation, the integration phase is <10ns, so settling must be faster than that to avoid errors.

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the opamp design. Scaled for 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical SC integrators in this speed range consume a few mW. The paper reports 12mW for the whole modulator.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the integration voltage step and settling time over multiple clock cycles using non-overlapping clocks.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Capacitor Integrator Testbench

.param C_val = 1p
.param V_in = 0.1

* DUT (Adapted for standard SPICE syntax)
XAo Vout XIN 0 amplifier
XS1 N3 Vin phi1 0 switch_ideal
CF Vout XIN {C_val}
CI N2 N3 {C_val}
XS2 XIN N2 phi2 0 switch_ideal
XS3 N3 0 phi2 0 switch_ideal
XS4 N2 0 phi1 0 switch_ideal

* Models and Subcircuits
.subckt switch_ideal n1 n2 ctrl ctrl_ref
S1 n1 n2 ctrl ctrl_ref sw_mod
.model sw_mod sw vt=0.9 vh=0.1 ron=100 roff=1G
.ends

.subckt amplifier out in_neg in_pos
* Simple Opamp Macro Model (Gain = 1000, GBW = 159MHz)
G1 0 int in_pos in_neg 1m
R1 int 0 1Meg
C1 int 0 1p
E1 out 0 int 0 1
.ends

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Rdummy VDD 0 1k
VVIN Vin 0 DC {V_in}
* 50MHz Non-overlapping clocks
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 0.1n 0.1n 9n 20n)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 0.1n 0.1n 9n 20n)

* Reset switch to initialize CF
XS_rst Vout XIN rst 0 switch_ideal
Vrst rst 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 0.1n 0.1n 19n 1000s)

.control
tran 0.1n 100n
* Measure voltage step between cycle 1 and cycle 2
meas tran vout_c1 find v(Vout) at=39n
meas tran vout_c2 find v(Vout) at=59n
let v_step = vout_c2 - vout_c1
print v_step

* Measure settling time during the 2nd active integration phase (3rd phi2 pulse)
* Vout goes from 0.1V to 0.2V; 90% of the step is 0.19V
meas tran t_settle trig v(phi2) val=0.9 rise=3 targ v(Vout) val=0.19 rise=1
print t_settle
quit
.endc
.end
